{{Top|leg}}
'''Gester Noxx''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] active [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Noxx marooned enemies in the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], including his greatest adversary, [[Zalin Lih]].<ref name="The Gangster's Graveyard">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Gangster's Graveyard}}</ref>
